technical-summary: S2: serving layout show/env, card-env and Radiance benchmark/sidecar assignments consume bc-serve C++ KFD/PCI BDF and HIP ordinal resolution; reject stale or duplicate GPU identity and validate BDF-scoped local power overrides. Launcher selects the same build's bc-serve before resolving. Synthetic KFD/PCI and stub-binary card-free tests cover matching roles and fail-closed behavior.
user-summary-candidate: Serving layouts use the live C++ GPU inventory instead of static host device indices, rejecting stale or duplicate PCI identities.
